scope: One synthetic changed investigation; not a model-accuracy benchmark
text:
Candidate hypothesis: payments v1.4.2. Changed 8 minutes before the synthetic alert; error increase 28 percentage points. Source: deployments/payments-v1.4.2.json. Causation is not established.

Customer exposure: 4 customers; $630,000 annual revenue exposed, not confirmed loss.

Atlas Market: atlas → checkout → payments. Sources: contracts/atlas.json, catalog/services/checkout.yaml.

Cedar Health: cedar → analytics → payments. Sources: contracts/cedar.json, catalog/services/analytics-change.yaml.

Northstar Retail: northstar → storefront → checkout → payments. Sources: contracts/northstar.json, catalog/services/storefront.yaml, catalog/services/checkout.yaml.

Orbit Labs: orbit → subscriptions → payments. Sources: contracts/orbit.json, catalog/services/subscriptions.yaml.

Response owner: Arjun Rao (Money movement; catalog/teams/money-movement.yaml).

Recorded memory: Checkout error rate above 25%, 2026-10-16T08:22:23.201Z. Outcome: Synthetic demo outcome: inspected payment pool saturation; reverting the pool configuration restored authorization success. Source: investigations/21b8eef9-c789-461a-8dc6-a93e342cb889.

Recorded memory: Payment connection pool exhausted, 2026-10-12T08:30:00Z. Outcome: Pool saturation confirmed; rollback restored authorizations in 4 minutes. Source: postmortems/INC-018.md.

Response: verify the deployment diff and live health signals. If the regression is confirmed, consider rollback to a verified known-good deployment. The prior version is not provided in this evidence.

The model selected the records and response category. This factual report is rendered from validated graph results. No production action or notification was executed.
validation: Deployment, exact customer set, response category, ownership, and memory checked against retrieved graph rows

trace.query: MATCH p=(alerted:Service {id:$service})-[:DEPENDS_ON*0..6]->(s:Service)<-[:DEPLOYED_TO]-(d:Deployment) WHERE d.minutesAgo <= 60 AND d.errorDelta > 0 RETURN d.id AS id, d.name AS name, d.summary AS summary, d.minutesAgo AS minutesAgo, d.errorDelta AS errorDelta, d.source AS source, s.id AS service, length(p) AS hops ORDER BY errorDelta DESC, minutesAgo ASC

MATCH p=(c:Customer)-[:USES]->(:Service)-[:DEPENDS_ON*0..6]->(s:Service {id:$service}) RETURN c.id AS id, c.name AS name, c.arr AS arr, c.tier AS tier, [n IN nodes(p) | n.id] AS path, [r IN relationships(p) | r.source] AS sources ORDER BY c.name
MATCH (s:Service {id:$service})-[:OWNED_BY]->(p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, p.team AS team, p.source AS source

MATCH (i:Incident)-[:ABOUT]->(s:Service {id:$service}) WHERE i.status = 'resolved' RETURN i.id AS id, i.title AS title, i.outcome AS outcome, i.fix AS fix, i.status AS status, i.createdAt AS createdAt, i.source AS source ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 8
